content: We have a holiday next week, don't we?
I'm probably going to spend the day looking at cars.
At cars! You aren't thinking about buying a car, are you?
Yes, I am. I'd like to be able to get around a little more.
But it will be expensive to have a car in the city, won't it?
Oh, I don't know. Of course, gasoline costs a lot these days.
But what about parking? You can't park on the street, can you?
A lot of people do. I'll try it for a while anyway, but I certainly don't want to pay a lot of parking tickets.
